entry.title: New: Bill 180 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 24-33, AS AMENDED, RELATING TO PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS AND FINANCING THEREOF FOR THE FISCAL YEAR JULY 1, 2024, TO JUNE 30, 2025

Adds the Police Department Hawaiʻi County Morgue project ($1.5 million) to the Capital Budget. Funds for this project shall be provided from General Obligation Bonds, Capital Projects Fund – Fund Balance and/or other Sources.

Latest action: Council: Bill 180 passes second & final reading - 8/21/2024
